svg.text: 14 tables · 23 foreign keys · MySQL / MariaDB. Shaded rows are primary keys; italics are foreign keys.
Technical note: the database contains 15 tables. schema_migrations is an operational migration-history table with no domain relationships, and is intentionally omitted from this domain ERD.
One match_claim links exactly two reports
One category has many breeds and reports
One address has one login_attempts counter
One user agrees once per notice version
One user is the actor on many audit_logs
Six tables were added. Three in the first revision: match_signals (why each pairing scored what it did, so matching is explainable rather than a
black box), notifications (the events users are told about) and moderation_cases (community flags and the decision taken). Three in the hardening
pass: login_attempts (the three-attempt lock, counted per address typed so the countdown reveals nothing), privacy_consents (who agreed to which
version of the notice) and audit_logs (who did what, and when). account_status gained a third value, locked, which nobody chooses.
